Centenarians Share Longevity Secrets in Separate Reports

Two separate reports highlight centenarians sharing their secrets to long life. In Japan, Kane Tanaka, the world's oldest person, lived to 115 and had previously shared her simple secrets to longevity. Separately, in Georgia, a woman celebrated her 112th birthday and also revealed her own secrets for a long life.
